title: St Mark's Basilica
source: Retained exact-QID way138800932 outline; current main parent and41 roof/dome/drum/crown/facade/annex parts, plus two inspected photographs.
identityStatus: Reviewed approximate connected basilica exterior: five mapped domes/drums/crowns, west piazza facade, cross-shaped roof ranges and selected adjoining annexes. Detached campanile and Doges Palace are separate sites.
axis: Native +X east along church toward apse; +Z south toward adjoining palace. West piazza facade resolves signed axis.

orientationControl.basis: West piazza/facade and south palace edge in both inspected photographs resolve the mapped nave/dome cross axis.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Main parent13m, mapped roof ranges6/12/14/17/21/23/24/27/28m, drums30m, four dome shells41m/central45m, four crowns46.5m/central50.5m and westfront controls13–26m/25–27.5m/25–29m are retained as nominal groups above an estimated0.7m floor. Their internal profiles, windows, facade arches, mosaic panels, horses and pinnacles are picture-led estimates.
reconstruction.scope: Connected basilica exterior and mapped small adjoining annexes, five lead domes/drums/onion crowns/crosses, cross-shaped roof ranges, layered west facade/narthex/five arches/closed rear doors, upper glazing/four simplified gold mosaic lunettes, balcony/pinnacles and four simplified bronze horses. Detached campanile, Doges Palace, surrounding city, full interiors and exact sculpture/artwork are excluded.
reconstruction.districtBasis: Fourteen principal mapped roof/annex controls, with eight-sided drum masks and merged lower roof. Small intermediate range subdivisions are omitted at district distance; street/closeup restore all mapped controls.
